verdict.rationale: Modal's pricing page and homepage describe self-serve, pay-as-you-go billing: pay by the second, only pay for what you use, no reserved capacity. That suggests developers can start without a sales conversation. However, nothing in the evidence mentions a free tier or included credits, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of a free tier or included monthly credits, explicit self-serve signup without sales contact, independent corroboration.
